id.description: Globally unique identifier for this place.

entityType.description: IFS entity category/type for this place.

basedOn.description: Id of the object this object is derived from.

entityDocumentationUrl.description: URL for documentation about this entity.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when this place record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when this place record was last updated.

name.description: Human-readable name of the real-world place.

coordinate.description: Optional latitude, longitude, and altitude location, represented as a comma-separated string.

geographicArea.description: Geographic area occupied by this place, including disconnected areas when applicable.

owners.description: IDs of entities that own this place.

roles.description: Role entities held by parties with responsibilities or authority regarding this place, such as stewardship, protection, management, improvement, construction, promotion, etc.
